info.title: API.SH: apna
info.description: The apna API from API.SH: public apna data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company on apna: its profile as the site shows it (name, logo, bio, turnover band, employee count, head office, social links) and its open jobs, which take the same filters as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apna-company

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Company id (from /apna/v1/suggest or company.id in job results).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One apna job in full: title, company, category, department, employment type, location with coordinates, salary details (fixed range, earning potential, incentives), experience, education, English, gender, shift, openings, skills, highlights, the job's detail sections, interview and company address, the full description (text and HTML) and dates. Pass an id or the job link; `latest=true` returns the newest job.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apna-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id (the number at the end of the job link).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: the newest job on the site.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches apna's jobs across India by keywords and location with every filter its job list offers: work mode (home, office, field), full or part time, day or night shift, date posted, education, English level, gender, minimum monthly salary, years of experience, distance from the place, and sort (relevant, salary, newest); or browses all jobs by city id, category, department or company without keywords. A typed place is matched to apna's places the way its location box does (see /apna/v1/locations). 20 jobs per page, each with `id`, `title`, `url`, company (id, name, logo), category, department, location (area, city, state, coordinates when given), salary text, fixed and maximum monthly salary, earning potential, experience, education, English, gender, shift, part-time and work-from-home flags, openings, tags and dates. `total` is the site's count (keyword searches stop at 500). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (page 50 at most).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apna-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords: job title, skill, company or department.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place for keyword searches: a city, region or area, e.g. pune, Andheri East.

parameters.name: education
parameters.description: 10th, 12th, diploma, iti, graduate or post-graduate (jobs open to that level).

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: apna city id (city_id in job results, e.g. 5 for Pune) to browse a city without keywords.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
